items.statement: Keep the existing recurring-pain/customer gate open and bind qualified workflow interviews before promoting the pain hypothesis.
Stage 7 may propose a separate deterministic implementation atom for scene IR plus constraint validation; Stage 5 design CI is not implementation evidence.
Keep rendering/backend selection blocked until an exact dependency graph and six-lane rights review exist; do not convert the source license summary into PASS.
Keep user and paid validation gates independent from technical progress; no public launch, price page, source claim, or green CI may satisfy them.
Preserve named-product internals as UNKNOWN or HYPOTHESIS until official technical evidence or independently observed runtime behavior is bound.
